info.name: RESTful Booker API
info.description: Production-grade API test collection for the public RESTful Booker API. Folders 01-08 mirror docs/test-scenarios.md IDs. Key responses carry inline JSON-schema assertions mirroring postman/schemas/*.json (Phase 7: CON-003/004/005). Chaining via token/bookingId/name variables written to both collection and environment scopes (Phase 8). Folder 07 pins observed negative contracts for defect review (Phase 9). Run: newman run postman/collections/restful-booker-api.postman_collection.json -e postman/environments/restful-booker.postman_environment.json. Response-time guards (2000ms, 10s cold-start-tolerant ping) are client-side smoke thresholds, not SLAs.
